title: Fleeing Man Points Gun Before Being Shot by St. Paul Police Officers
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Saint Paul, Minnesota — On December 21, 2025, at approximately 3 p.m. General Motors was electronically tracking a stolen Buick Envista and notified police the vehicle was in Saint Paul. Officers located the vehicle and began following it in a SPPD marked squad as it entered westbound I-94 from Highway 52. General Motors then remotely disabled the vehicle. The driver, identified by the Minnesota Bureau of Criminal Apprehension as 32-year-old Elliot Vaughn, of Minneapolis, and a female passenger exited the vehicle and ran. According to the BCA's preliminary investigation, Vaughn pulled out a handgun from his waistband and pointed it at Officers Foy and Treangen. Both officers fired their service weapons at Vaughn, striking him in the leg. Officers provided medical aid to Vaughn before he was transported to Regions Hospital and then booked into jail after he was medically cleared. The female passenger was located and taken into custody a short time later. No other injuries were reported. Vaughn has since been charged with two counts of first-degree assault, two counts of second-degree assault, and a single count of theft of a motor vehicle.
